question.en: What is the writer's carpet made of?
question.zh: 作者的地毯是用什么做的？

sentences.en: What is the writer's carpet made of?
sentences.zh: 作者的地毯是用什么做的？

sentences.en: We have just moved into a new house and I have been working hard all morning.
sentences.zh: 我们刚搬进新居，我一上午都在忙着收拾。

sentences.en: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
sentences.zh: 我一直在设法把新房间整理好。

sentences.en: This has not been easy because I own over a thousand books.
sentences.zh: 这并不容易，因为我有一千多本书。

chunks.x: because I own over a thousand books

sentences.en: so I have temporarily put my books on the floor.
sentences.zh: 所以我只好暂时把书放在地板上。

sentences.en: At the moment, they cover every inch of floor space
sentences.zh: 这会儿，书把每一寸地板都占满了，

sentences.en: and I actually have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.
sentences.zh: 我进出房间得踩着书走。

chunks.x: in or out of the room

sentences.en: A short while ago, my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
sentences.zh: 刚才我妹妹帮我把一只旧书柜搬上了楼。

sentences.en: She went into my room and got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
sentences.zh: 她走进我的房间，看到地板上那些书大吃一惊。

sentences.en: 'This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen,' she said.
sentences.zh: “这是我见过的最漂亮的地毯，”她说。

chunks.x: This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen

sentences.en: She gazed at it for some time then added,
sentences.zh: 她盯着看了好一会儿，然后又说，

sentences.en: You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet!'
sentences.zh: 你闲着的时候可以坐在这儿读地毯！”
